load_bert_state: load a BERT state dict from HuggingFace and convert it to a ParlAI model state dict
load_dpr_model: load a pretrained DPR model checkpoint into a BERT model for query or document encoding
convert_bert_to_parlai: convert a HuggingFace BERT state dict to a ParlAI-compatible state dict with remapped keys
review_BERT_EMB_DICT_MAP: review the BERT embedding key mapping dictionary that translates HuggingFace keys to ParlAI keys
review_BERT_COMPATIBILITY_KEYS: review the list of BERT weight keys that are unnecessary in the ParlAI model
